DECOY.gloss: a beguiler who leads someone into danger
DECOY.definition: A beguiler who leads someone into danger (usually as part of a plot).

CODE.gloss: a set of rules or principles or laws
CODE.definition: A set of rules or principles or laws (especially written ones).

DECO.gloss: a style of design that was popular in the 1920s and 1930s
DECO.definition: A style of design that was popular in the 1920s and 1930s; marked by stylized forms and geometric designs adapted to mass production.

DOC.example: I felt so bad I went to see my doctor.

DEC.gloss: the angular distance of a celestial body north or to the south of the celestial equator
DEC.definition: (astronomy) the angular distance of a celestial body north or to the south of the celestial equator; expressed in degrees; used with right ascension to specify positions on the celestial sphere.

COD.gloss: the vessel that contains the seeds of a plant
COD.definition: The vessel that contains the seeds of a plant (not the seeds themselves).

DOE.gloss: mature female of mammals of which the male is called `buck'
DOE.definition: Mature female of mammals of which the male is called `buck'.
